entities.name: PMID:25424483
observations: 2014 Molecular Brain primary study of simvastatin in primary cultured rat microglia.
Simvastatin at 20 μM was reported as non-toxic and reduced cellular cholesterol by approximately 18%.
The study reported cholesterol-dependent changes in mediator release and cholesterol-independent inhibition of phagocytosis.

entities.name: Simvastatin
observations: In primary cultured rat microglia, simvastatin altered release of IL-1β, TNF-α, and BDNF; the secretory phenotype was reported as cholesterol-dependent.
Simvastatin inhibited microglial phagocytosis through a cholesterol-independent effect in the same study.

entities.name: Cholesterol-dependent secretion
observations: In primary cultured rat microglia treated with simvastatin, changes in IL-1β, TNF-α, and BDNF release were reported as cholesterol-dependent; cytokine-specific direction and magnitude were not uniform in the available summary.

entities.name: Cholesterol-independent phagocytosis
observations: In primary cultured rat microglia, simvastatin inhibited phagocytosis despite the authors reporting that this effect was cholesterol-independent.
